note: Apps deploy concurrently on their own AppRelease rows; runtime, binary, rollback and env calls are exclusive.

cases.id: an app deploy is handed to the app's own release row

payload.cmd: mkdir -p '/srv/orb/apps/shop/releases' && cd '/srv/orb/apps/shop' && ls -1 releases | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | sort -n | tail -n 1; true

cases.id: two apps deploy at once
control: a second deploy of an app in flight is busy
the release row takes the number after the highest on the server
control: an app with no releases yet takes release 1
the release row links current by one rename and keeps three

payload.cmd: cd '/srv/orb/apps/shop' && if [ -d current ] && [ ! -L current ]; then mkdir -p releases && rm -rf releases/0 && mv current releases/0; fi && ln -sfn 'releases/3' current.next && perl -e 'rename shift, shift or exit 1' current.next current && { cd releases && ls -1 | sort -rn | tail -n +4 | while read -r d; do rm -rf -- "$d"; done; true; }

cases.id: a failed rsync answers at rsync and records nothing
a linked release is answered with its number
a finished app frees its name and is answered
a runtime deploy waits for no app and is refused while one is in flight
a runtime deploy rsyncs the context, then the stack without its env
an unhealthy runtime goes back to the previous image
control: a binary deploy is refused under runtime docker
an empty host refuses the deploy before any command
a stack env line is replaced and applied

payload.cmd: cd '/srv/orb/stack' && { grep -v '^CORS_ORIGIN=' .env > .env.next || true; } && printf '%s\n' 'CORS_ORIGIN=https://a.web.app,https://b.web.app' >> .env.next && chmod 600 .env.next && mv .env.next .env && docker compose up -d

cases.id: a systemd binary deploy rsyncs, swaps, restarts, checks health and answers

payload.cmd: cd '/srv/orb/bin' && { test ! -e orb || cp -p orb orb.prev; } && mv -f orb.new orb

cases.id: a rollback links the earlier release folder

payload.cmd: cd '/srv/orb/apps/shop' && test -d 'releases/2' && ln -sfn 'releases/2' current.next && perl -e 'rename shift, shift or exit 1' current.next current
